thread:
sergey: heads-up  KazCompute reached out to list an Astana (kz-astana) marketplace SKU that bundles their LocalSys SI integration + hardware. they want entitlement + customs/compliance signoff + quota before vendor listing. timeline: pilot customers in 3 weeks.
anya: do we have a partner SKU id or pricing? will this be a marketplace-only SKU or an SI bundle?
sergey: placeholder SKU KC-KZ-AST-01. it's an SI bundle (LocalSys will handle local on-prem hookups). partner requests cert pinning, customs paperwork for cross-border telemetry, and a small committed pool to start.
marta: legal/ops note: Kazakhstan requires some local data residency disclosures. if telemetry contains customer identifiers, we need local counsel signoff. also confirm who stores keys.
ivan_ops: ops: network & infra questions  do we need a dedicated subnet carve for LocalSys? any ASN peering? what GPU class?
sergey: KazCompute asked for 12 A2-equivalent GPUs (they claim A2-like), 100 vCPU for control-plane, and 6TB egress cap for month 1. they also asked for a separate subnet per integrator and an ASN for peering.
marta: legal prefers BYOK for production. for pilot partner offered RW-managed keys for faster onboarding if we add key custody clauses. i'll draft an MOA with fallback language.
anya: partner also asked for customs clearance template for telemetry packets (no PII), and proof of local processing. can we supply an architecture diagram with redwood-only processing in-country?
ivan_ops: technically yes. we can pin processing to kz-astana region and emit only anonymized usage telemetry. need to verify with infra team on routing rules.
infra-bot: ticket created: MKP-5521  kz-astana entitlement + ASN/peering checklist + KMS flow (assignee: ivan_ops). ETA: 2026-07-08.
sergey: thanks. immediate asks: (1) vote on RW-managed keys for pilot vs BYOK (reply "+rw" or "+byok"), (2) confirm GPU/vCPU numbers or suggest changes, (3) volunteer to intro LocalSys PM on thread.
marta: +byok (legal pushes BYOK even for pilots if partner can support; will accept RW-managed only with extra appendix)
ivan_ops: +rw (ops can host keys for a 30d pilot if legal ok with the appendix; speeds launch)
anya: +byok (we should avoid long-term custody)
sergey: noted split. i'll push partner to accept BYOK for production and offer RW-managed as short-term pilot only if MOA appendix is signed.
infra-bot: reminder: entitlement review sync on 2026-07-06 14:00 ALMT (calendar invite sent).
sergey: can someone intro @marat_localsys? i'll loop in marketing for the co-branded listing and customs comms. ping if blockers.
